integrity: The exact formulas are derived from the primary source definitions by symmetry and an elementary one-dimensional integral. Numerical quadrature is corroborative only and is not used as proof.
limitations: The exact closed forms are specific to the two-dimensional nearest-neighbour finite-support model, while the relation between the two threshold constants holds for the source model in every dimension \(n\ge2\).
No new upper-threshold classification is claimed.
A closely related 2021 small-rank-perturbation article could not be reliably inspected in full and is retained as an originality risk.
title: Exact critical lines in the two-dimensional nearest-neighbor lattice delta model
